run_eval_metric: run eval_metric.py to evaluate detection metric results saved in pkl format against a model config
build_eval_dataset: build a dataset from mmdet config for offline metric evaluation of detection predictions
test_evaluator_offline: test the Evaluator offline_evaluate method with precomputed pickle predictions and dataset metadata
create_eval_config: create an evaluation config with val_evaluator settings and test_dataloader for metric computation
review_parse_args: review the parse_args function that configures argparse for config path, pkl results, and cfg-options overrides
